title: Get Zedu listed in 20 online directories
description: Get Zedu listed in 20 online directories within 30 days. This means finding trusted business, startup, and software directories, submitting Zedu's name, link, and short description to each one, and keeping a list of every listing. Progress is measured by the number of directories where Zedu is live.

Deliver a sourced inventory and correction queue; do not claim or edit profiles.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Write one listing pack, then submit to 20 ranked directories in batches and log each
acceptedWorkstreams.description:
Most directories ask for the same things (name, link, short and long description, category, logo, screenshots), so writing them once keeps every listing consistent and makes 20 submissions quick. Steps, each a finishable task:
1. Directory shortlist (research): 25 free or low-cost software, startup and edtech directories ranked by relevance, review time and requirements, so 20 can still go live if some reject or stall.
2. Listing pack (content): the name, a tagline, descriptions at 50, 160 and 300 words, categories and tags, and logo and screenshot files in the common sizes. Every claim must match the live site. Reuse the EdTech listing pack task already open in this project where it overlaps.
3. Submissions (other): submit in batches of 5 and record the directory, date, listing URL and status in one sheet.
4. Live check: recheck pending listings weekly and fix any that get rejected.
Progress is the goal's own measure: the number of directories where Zedu is live, each with a link.
